item.title: From predicting words to modelling worlds: four ideas, one city
item.description: Predicting the next word, reasoning, and two kinds of world model: four ideas behind today’s AI models, explained with one taxi ride through Kavala, and where attacks can enter at each step.

item.title: Indexes and AI assistants: where retrieval meets security
item.description: An AI assistant reads only the pages its index hands over. How vectors and embeddings choose those pages, why that helps, and why the index is also one place where poisoning, indirect injection and leakage enter.
